output.reason: On its own, the cited item [ev-204dcfc64ffc] is just a bare metric name. Its section intro [ev-1f419676f177] gives the missing details. It says the `cortex_` prefix on these listed metrics changes to `loki_` in this release, so this metric is renamed to `loki_prometheus_rule_evaluation_duration_seconds_sum`. The exposure condition is that `metrics_namespace` is left at the default `loki`, because setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name. The consequence is that the metric stops being exposed under its `cortex_` name, so anything that queries the old name stops getting data, unless the operator renames those references or sets the namespace to `cortex`.
